description.value: Royston House B&B is a carriage-house loft suite set on 2+ park-like acres in the seaside community of Royston, just outside Courtenay on Vancouver Island. The property fronts directly onto the Royston Waterfront Trail along Comox Bay, and is recognised as a Canadian Wildlife Certified Backyard Habitat with woodlands, ponds, and deer trails. Guests stay in a self-contained suite with a private entrance and covered ocean-view deck, and breakfast is served in a glass-enclosed plant solarium.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active B&B at 3700 Hilton Road, Royston (Courtenay), BC with phone (250) 897-9077 matching OSM. The mobile subpage explicitly states 'You can stay connected with our Shaw Wi-Fi high speed internet,' confirming Wi-Fi. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, tools, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address ('3700 Hilton Road') lacks city and postal code; website provides full address '3700 Hilton Road Courtenay (Royston) BC V9N 9T4' — used website value.
Blog content dates from 2013–2014 and site copyright reads 2020; site may not be actively maintained, though availability calendar and contact form appear functional.
Website coordinates (lat 49.6515155, long -124.955964) differ slightly from OSM coordinates (49.652218, -124.955423) — minor but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Royston House is a legitimate, active B&B in a cycling-friendly coastal area with direct trail access, but the website contains no evidence of secure bike storage or staff bike procedures, which are the two required WWC criteria. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether these services are available.
enrichment_extras.notes: A toll-free number (1-778-585-4066) appears on the website in addition to the local number recorded in OSM. The property's direct frontage on the Royston Waterfront Trail makes it potentially attractive to cycle tourers; confirming bike storage would likely qualify it for inclusion.
